en: ## Installation
zh: ## 安装

en: The first step is to install Rust. We’ll download Rust through `rustup`, a command line tool for managing Rust versions and associated tools. You’ll need an internet connection for the download.
zh: 第一步是安装 Rust。我们将通过 `rustup` 下载 Rust，这是一个用于管理 Rust 版本及相关工具的命令行工具。下载时需要网络连接。

en: Note: If you prefer not to use `rustup` for some reason, please see the [Other Rust Installation Methods page](https://forge.rust-lang.org/infra/other-installation-methods.html) for more options.
zh: 注意：如果你出于某种原因不想使用 `rustup`，请参阅[其他 Rust 安装方式页面](https://forge.rust-lang.org/infra/other-installation-methods.html)了解更多选项。

en: The following steps install the latest stable version of the Rust compiler. Rust’s stability guarantees ensure that all the examples in the book that compile will continue to compile with newer Rust versions. The output might differ slightly between versions because Rust often improves error messages and warnings. In other words, any newer, stable version of Rust you install using these steps should work as expected with the content of this book.
zh: 以下步骤安装的是 Rust 编译器的最新稳定版本。Rust 的稳定性保证确保书中所有能够编译的示例在较新的 Rust 版本中仍然可以编译。不同版本之间的输出可能略有差异，因为 Rust 经常改进错误消息和警告。换句话说，使用这些步骤安装的任何更新的稳定版本 Rust 都应当能按预期配合本书内容使用。

en: ### Command Line Notation
zh: ### 命令行标记

en: In this chapter and throughout the book, we’ll show some commands used in the terminal. Lines that you should enter in a terminal all start with `$`. You don’t need to type the `$` character; it’s the command line prompt shown to indicate the start of each command. Lines that don’t start with `$` typically show the output of the previous command. Additionally, PowerShell-specific examples will use `>` rather than `$`.
zh: 在本章以及全书当中，我们会展示一些在终端中使用的命令。你需要在终端中输入的行都以 `$` 开头。你不需要输入 `$` 字符；它是显示出来表示每条命令开始位置的命令行提示符。不以 `$` 开头的行通常显示上一条命令的输出。此外，PowerShell 专用的示例会使用 `>` 而不是 `$`。

en: ### Installing `rustup` on Linux or macOS
zh: ### 在 Linux 或 macOS 上安装 `rustup`

en: If you’re using Linux or macOS, open a terminal and enter the following command:
zh: 如果你使用的是 Linux 或 macOS，请打开终端并输入以下命令：

en:
```console
$ curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh
```
zh:
```console
$ curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh
```

en: The command downloads a script and starts the installation of the `rustup` tool, which installs the latest stable version of Rust. You might be prompted for your password. If the install is successful, the following line will appear:
zh: 该命令会下载一个脚本并开始安装 `rustup` 工具，它会安装最新稳定版本的 Rust。可能会提示你输入密码。如果安装成功，将出现下面这一行：

en:
```text
Rust is installed now. Great!
```
zh:
```text
Rust is installed now. Great!
```

en: You will also need a *linker*, which is a program that Rust uses to join its compiled outputs into one file. It is likely you already have one. If you get linker errors, you should install a C compiler, which will typically include a linker. A C compiler is also useful because some common Rust packages depend on C code and will need a C compiler.
zh: 你还需要一个*链接器*（linker），它是 Rust 用来将编译输出合并成一个文件的程序。你很可能已经拥有一个。如果遇到链接器错误，你应该安装一个 C 编译器，它通常包含链接器。C 编译器也很有用，因为一些常见的 Rust 包依赖 C 代码，需要 C 编译器。

en: On macOS, you can get a C compiler by running:
zh: 在 macOS 上，你可以通过运行以下命令获得 C 编译器：

en:
```console
$ xcode-select --install
```
zh:
```console
$ xcode-select --install
```

en: Linux users should generally install GCC or Clang, according to their distribution’s documentation. For example, if you use Ubuntu, you can install the `build-essential` package.
zh: Linux 用户通常应根据其发行版的文档安装 GCC 或 Clang。例如，如果你使用 Ubuntu，可以安装 `build-essential` 包。

en: ### Installing `rustup` on Windows
zh: ### 在 Windows 上安装 `rustup`

en: On Windows, go to [https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install](https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install) and follow the instructions for installing Rust. At some point in the installation, you’ll be prompted to install Visual Studio. This provides a linker and the native libraries needed to compile programs. If you need more help with this step, see [https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/installation/windows-msvc.html](https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/installation/windows-msvc.html).
zh: 在 Windows 上，请访问 [https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install](https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install) 并按照说明安装 Rust。在安装的某个阶段，系统会提示你安装 Visual Studio，它提供编译程序所需的链接器和本机库。如果你在这一步需要更多帮助，请参阅 [https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/installation/windows-msvc.html](https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/installation/windows-msvc.html)。

en: The rest of this book uses commands that work in both *cmd.exe* and PowerShell. If there are specific differences, we’ll explain which to use.
zh: 本书其余部分使用的命令在 *cmd.exe* 和 PowerShell 中都可以使用。如果有具体差异，我们会说明应使用哪一个。

en: ### Troubleshooting
zh: ### 疑难解答

en: To check whether you have Rust installed correctly, open a shell and enter this line:
zh: 要检查 Rust 是否正确安装，请打开 shell 并输入这一行：

en:
```console
$ rustc --version
```
zh:
```console
$ rustc --version
```

en: You should see the version number, commit hash, and commit date for the latest stable version that has been released, in the following format:
zh: 你应该会看到已发布的最新稳定版本的版本号、提交哈希和提交日期，格式如下：

en:
```text
rustc x.y.z (abcabcabc yyyy-mm-dd)
```
zh:
```text
rustc x.y.z (abcabcabc yyyy-mm-dd)
```

en: If you see this information, you have installed Rust successfully! If you don’t see this information, check that Rust is in your `%PATH%` system variable as follows.
zh: 如果你看到了这些信息，说明 Rust 已成功安装！如果没有看到，请按以下方式检查 Rust 是否位于你的 `%PATH%` 系统变量中。

en: In Windows CMD, use:
zh: 在 Windows CMD 中，使用：

en:
```console
> echo %PATH%
```
zh:
```console
> echo %PATH%
```

en: In PowerShell, use:
zh: 在 PowerShell 中，使用：

en:
```powershell
> echo $env:Path
```
zh:
```powershell
> echo $env:Path
```

en: In Linux and macOS, use:
zh: 在 Linux 和 macOS 中，使用：

en:
```console
$ echo $PATH
```
zh:
```console
$ echo $PATH
```

en: If that’s all correct and Rust still isn’t working, there are a number of places you can get help. Find out how to get in touch with other Rustaceans (a silly nickname we call ourselves) on [the community page](https://www.rust-lang.org/community).
zh: 如果以上都正确而 Rust 仍然无法使用，还有多个地方可以获得帮助。你可以在[社区页面](https://www.rust-lang.org/community)上了解如何联系其他 Rustacean（我们给自己起的俏皮昵称）。

en: ### Updating and Uninstalling
zh: ### 更新与卸载

en: Once Rust is installed via `rustup`, updating to a newly released version is easy. From your shell, run the following update script:
zh: 通过 `rustup` 安装 Rust 后，更新到新发布的版本很容易。在 shell 中运行以下更新脚本：

en:
```console
$ rustup update
```
zh:
```console
$ rustup update
```

en: To uninstall Rust and `rustup`, run the following uninstall script from your shell:
zh: 要卸载 Rust 和 `rustup`，请在 shell 中运行以下卸载脚本：

en:
```console
$ rustup self uninstall
```
zh:
```console
$ rustup self uninstall
```

en: ### Reading the Local Documentation
zh: ### 阅读本地文档

en: The installation of Rust also includes a local copy of the documentation so that you can read it offline. Run `rustup doc` to open the local documentation in your browser.
zh: Rust 的安装还包括一份本地文档副本，以便你离线阅读。运行 `rustup doc` 即可在浏览器中打开本地文档。

en: Any time a type or function is provided by the standard library and you’re not sure what it does or how to use it, use the application programming interface (API) documentation to find out!
zh: 每当标准库提供了某个类型或函数，而你不确定它的作用或用法时，就查阅应用程序编程接口（API）文档来了解吧！

en: ### Using Text Editors and IDEs
zh: ### 使用文本编辑器和 IDE

en: This book makes no assumptions about what tools you use to author Rust code. Just about any text editor will get the job done! However, many text editors and integrated development environments (IDEs) have built-in support for Rust. You can always find a fairly current list of many editors and IDEs on [the tools page](https://www.rust-lang.org/tools) on the Rust website.
zh: 本书不对你使用什么工具编写 Rust 代码做任何假设。几乎任何文本编辑器都能完成任务！不过，许多文本编辑器和集成开发环境（IDE）都内置了对 Rust 的支持。你总能在 Rust 网站上的[工具页面](https://www.rust-lang.org/tools)找到一份相当新的编辑器和 IDE 列表。

en: ### Working Offline with This Book
zh: ### 离线使用本书

en: In several examples, we will use Rust packages beyond the standard library. To work through those examples, you will either need to have an internet connection or to have downloaded those dependencies ahead of time. To download the dependencies ahead of time, you can run the following commands. (We’ll explain what `cargo` is and what each of these commands does in detail later.)
zh: 在若干示例中，我们会使用标准库之外的 Rust 包。要完成这些示例，你需要有网络连接，或者提前下载好这些依赖。要提前下载依赖，可以运行以下命令。（稍后我们会详细解释 `cargo` 是什么，以及这些命令各自的作用。）

en:
```console
$ cargo new get-dependencies
$ cd get-dependencies
$ cargo add rand@0.10.1 trpl@0.2.0
```
zh:
```console
$ cargo new get-dependencies
$ cd get-dependencies
$ cargo add rand@0.10.1 trpl@0.2.0
```

en: This will cache the downloads for these packages so you will not need to download them later. Once you have run this command, you do not need to keep the `get-dependencies` folder. If you have run this command, you can use the `--offline` flag with all `cargo` commands in the rest of the book to use these cached versions instead of attempting to use the network.
zh: 这样会缓存这些包的下载内容，因此你之后无需再次下载。运行完这条命令后，你不需要保留 `get-dependencies` 文件夹。如果你已经运行过这条命令，那么在本书其余部分的所有 `cargo` 命令中都可以使用 `--offline` 标志，以使用这些缓存版本而不尝试访问网络。
